faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know before you dive in — no jargon, no catch.

items.q: Is it really free? What's the catch?
items.a: There isn't one. The Amateur plan is free forever, no credit card required: unlimited bookings, 5 services, automatic confirmations and your online booking page. If your business grows, the Pro plan at €19/month unlocks automatic reminders, Google Calendar sync and unlimited services — with a free trial month.

items.q: Does BranShee take a commission on my bookings?
items.a: No, never. Unlike some platforms that take a percentage or charge per appointment, BranShee runs on a flat subscription. 100% of what your clients pay goes to you, and your clients stay your clients.

items.q: Is the free plan really unlimited?
items.a: Bookings are unlimited, with no credit card and no expiry date. The Amateur plan includes 5 services and your booking page. Automatic reminders, Google Calendar sync and customisation are reserved for the paid plans.

items.q: How long does it take to get up and running?
items.a: Under 10 minutes for most professionals: create your account, add your services and hours, share your link on Instagram, WhatsApp or your website. No technical skills needed.

items.q: Do my clients need to create an account or install an app?
items.a: No. Your clients book in 30 seconds from any browser, with their name and email. No mandatory account, no app to download. Your page is available in 6 languages (French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch).

items.q: Can I embed the booking calendar on my own website?
items.a: Yes. BranShee provides a widget you can embed on your site (WordPress, Wix, custom-built…) by copying a single line of code: your clients book without leaving your website. And if you don't have a site, BranShee generates one for you, publishable in 1 click.

items.q: How does BranShee reduce missed appointments (no-shows)?
items.a: Three mechanisms: an automatic email reminder 24h before every appointment, a cancellation policy you define, and online payment via Stripe — deposit or card on file, so missed appointments no longer come out of your pocket.

items.q: Can I manage a team and control who has access to what?
items.a: Yes. Invite team members to your business, set schedules and time off per employee, and create roles with precise permissions: who can manage schedules, book time off, edit services… An activity log tracks who did what.

items.q: Is BranShee a good alternative to Planity, Calendly or SimplyBook?
items.a: Yes. BranShee is a complete online booking software built for independents and small teams: the same essential features (online calendar, reminders, payments, team management), but starting at €0, with no commission, your brand front and center, and human support.
